notes.title: Regular updates 1.12A
notes.content:
1.Fixed the issue where the UI did not display when Yukino and Elina changed outfits.
2.Removed the camera zoom function during battles to avoid various bugs caused by camera zoom.
3.Optimized the over-the-shoulder perspective.
4.Increased the aiming reticle movement speed.
5.Fixed some UI clarity issues.
6.Fixed some scene placement bugs.

notes.title: 1.11b update introduces new characters Elina and Yukino
notes.content:
The update includes two new characters, Elina and Yukino.
[b]Elina unlock condition: Clear stage 3-1 on Hard difficulty.
Yukino unlock condition: Clear stage 4-1 on Hard difficulty.
[/b]


A new appreciation scene, the bar, has been added.
Bar unlock condition: Clear stage 3-1 on Hard difficulty.

[b]Note: Even players who have cleared the game before need to re-clear stage 3-1 and 4-1 on Hard difficulty to unlock the new characters!
[/b]
Bug fix: Fixed the bug where the camera focal length would reset when returning after aiming down sights.

notes.title: Ver 1.1 Update is coming soon
notes.content:
Ver 1.1 Update is coming soon.
We expect the update to arrive in mid-November, introducing two brand new characters. 
The author experienced a bout of depression in the past few months, which hindered the development process. 
As a result, the promised update has been delayed until now. We apologize for any inconvenience caused."

notes.title: V1.02b version update, fixed several bugs, and launched Trading card
notes.content:
1. Fix the problem of too low damage caused by Tiya Poison Thunder

2. Repair the problem of air wall falling out of the map in the appreciation room - hospital

3. Fix the sound problem of male jumping in the appreciation room

4. Fix accuracy issues with automatic rifle weapons

5. Fix weapon supernovae that will become a bug in Beast AK after exiting the game and re-entering

6. Fix bugs that cannot be resurrected due to crouching death

7. Fix the bug where Fina's Skill:turret is unable to attack floating drones



Updated the collection function of Trading Cards, now you can obtain Trading Cards, Badges, Backgrounds, etc



Next update trailer: 2 new characters, 1 new map, multiple new costumes, etc., expected to be updated in July/August.

Thank you for your support

notes.title: GunSoulGirl 2 1.01a update
notes.content:
Corrected the handle, dispersion rate and recoil of most firearms

We have created a character reset function, which can now be used to solve the problem of being stuck in a level and unable to replace people (not necessary, as resetting may also cause other displacement and displacement issues)

Corrected the Doctor's Guild plot to reduce the damage caused by killing light balls

Fixed the issue of blocking levels when killing a boss before the battle

Fixed lens issue with sniper guns

Greatly reduce the unreasonable damage caused by Miyu.

Increase Merlin's grenade damage

Fixed the unreasonable sudden death issue of Merlin

Fixed issue with display of accessories and movement speed

Fixed some issues with equipment display and numerical increase

Fixed issue with self exploding spiders still moving to chase people after death

Fixed the issue of genetic monsters still moving to chase people after their death

Fixed issue with missing mecha materials in 4-3 animations

Fixed a material loss issue with Rinko and Miyu skills

Boss Death Slow Shot Stuck Function Removal

Added currency pickup judgment range

Fix the sound bug in the appreciation room, now the volume can be adjusted in the appreciation room.

Added text prompt for appreciation room mouse scroll wheel

Slightly fixed flicker issue, which may reduce the probability of flicker occurrence

Fixed several issues with air wall falling out in the first chapter

Fixed issue with no sound from Hellfire guns

Unrefixed: Occasional character equipment display issues may occur. Please exit the game and restart.
